title: 第五章 参加电视目录制5第六章 回归平静
content_zh:
紫萱的笑容很迷人，她似乎为我在总结：“你的‘是的’这两个字承载的重量很重。
算是80后的现实和理想角力的重量叠加。”
我的眼睛从左边的紫萱扫过到了右边的观众方向，再扫了回来，她的眼神依然在等待着我的眼睛扫过来，就像那棵著名了几千年也不见长高的树，一动不动的等我这只没有交规概念的兔子撞了上来。
我的脑壳真的好像给树干撞晕了的感觉，她的眼神，柔里带刚。
我说：“我想要做的悬崖酒店，是想把它建设成天堂鸟的巢。”
紫萱哦了一声：“天堂鸟？琼瑶写过一本书，就叫天堂鸟。”
我嗯了一声算是回应：“我听过这部小说但没看过。
天堂鸟有着无与伦比的漂亮羽毛，人们都在传说它是一种没有脚的鸟儿，从不见栖息在树上，比只栖息梧桐树的凤凰更加傲娇。
传说中，人们从没见过天堂鸟栖息在什么树上。”
紫萱紧追不舍：“于是你就决意造一座这样的酒店？”
我回答：“这是属于天堂鸟的巢。
人生天地间忽如远行客，总要有给自己旅行的心灵一个家。
当然，这个家不是传统意义上的家。”
紫萱开始下套了：“这不就是民宿吗？是属于高级别的民宿，或者这么说，高高在上的民宿，因为高，悬崖酒店嘛！”
我对她的话题有警觉性：“从建筑形式而言，你可以将悬崖酒店归类民宿或者度假酒店。
但是从象征意义来说，它就是天堂鸟的巢。”
紫萱的笑脸里依然带着进攻的因子：“为什么是天堂鸟而不是凤凰？或者是鹰？凤凰和鹰，应该是是可以作为80后真实写照的。”
如果我要和她围绕这话题下去的话，也许会给牵着鼻子走，如果不围绕这话题，就跑题了。
只有小心翼翼的展开了。
好不容易上个节目也要斗智斗勇，有点累，心里设想的让这节目为我的梦想打call，现在看来，有点将镜花水月的感觉，这会这镜花水月的就算完全坐实了。

想到这里，我心里便有了个底，这个底，权当算是李大霄式的婴儿底吧！
我说：“如果只用凤凰和鹰来比喻80后，但我觉的少了点，80后的类型，应该是百鸟园一样，用一句俗话说，‘林子大了，什么鸟都有’，你看看现在我们国家发展得这么好，像不像一个大林子？”
紫萱哈哈的笑了起来：“以鸟喻人，这个可以有，我们现在有自由且蔚蓝的天空。
不过，既然是百鸟都有，那么用凤凰和鹰比喻80后的类型，也算是恰如其分了。
百鸟朝凤，对吧？”
我看见现场的场务在场下对观众做了个鼓掌的手势。
掌声在这句话之后响了起来。
虽然不太响亮，但我知道紫萱的团队是强大的，后期剪辑和添加效果比如单个观众的笑脸之类的锦上添花般的绝对是杠杠的好。
事后我看到的节目效果的确如此。
我一听紫萱这么说，我就突然很想和她抬抬杠：“80后的标签有个很明显的性格特点就是个性鲜明，不轻易明着给自己贴标签，也不轻易将自己崇拜感廉价卖给谁。
你这样说百鸟朝凤，言下之意就是只要是鸟，就必须朝凤了。
我不认为80后是这样的。”
紫萱给我这样猝不及防的将了一军，不怒反喜，那双大眼睛反而更加的水灵动人，虽然这种水灵动人与我而言毫无感觉，也许一般的男士早就深陷其中，欲拔不拔了。
我只喜欢我老婆的眼神，第一眼见她的时候便被她的眼睛迷住了，我的文字功底差，不会像屈原那样用文字来描述女神的眼睛，对于我来说，我反正一见她的眼神就欢喜了。
紫萱说：“你的意思就是各鸟各飞？天高任鸟飞？”
我说：“我觉得是这样的，当然不代表就都是这样的。
我的意思是80后都是有担待的一代，更是有压力的一代，相当多的80后都是独生子女，都是要面对2养411的现实的。
一对夫妻，赡养4个老人，一个孩子，现在放开二胎了，2养6，也许双方父母都有医保社保，但是我们这一代精神压力比较大。
content_en:
Zixuan’s smile was charming, and she seemed to be summarizing it for me: “Your words ‘yes’ carry a heavy weight.
It can be regarded as the superposition of the weight of the struggle between reality and ideals of the post-80s generation. "
My eyes swept from Zixuan on the left to the audience on the right, and back again. Her eyes were still waiting for my eyes to sweep over, just like the famous tree that has not grown taller for thousands of years, waiting motionless for me, a rabbit with no concept of traffic rules, to bump into her.
My head really felt like I was knocked unconscious by a tree trunk. Her eyes were soft but strong.
I said: "The cliff hotel I want to build is to build it into a nest for birds of paradise."
Zixuan exclaimed: "Bird of Paradise? Qiong Yao wrote a book called Bird of Paradise."
I hummed in response: "I've heard of this novel but haven't read it.
The bird of paradise has unparalleled beautiful feathers. People say that it is a bird without legs and has never been seen perching on trees. It is more arrogant than the phoenix that only inhabits sycamore trees.
According to legend, people have never seen the bird of paradise perching on any tree. "
Zixuan chased after her: "So you decided to build a hotel like this?"
I replied: "This is the nest of the Bird of Paradise.
Life is like a traveler in the world. There must always be a home for your traveling soul.
Of course, this home is not a home in the traditional sense. "
Zixuan started to trick her: "Isn't this a B&B? It's a high-end B&B, or in other words, a high-end B&B. Because it's high, it's a cliff hotel!"
I was alert to her topic: “In terms of architectural form, you can classify the Cliff Hotel as a B&B or a resort hotel.
But symbolically, it is the nest of the bird of paradise. "
Zixuan's smile still carries an element of offense: "Why is it a bird of paradise and not a phoenix? Or an eagle? The phoenix and the eagle should be true portrayals of the post-80s generation."
If I want to focus on this topic with her, I may be led by the nose. If we don't focus on this topic, we will go off topic.
Only unfolded carefully.
I finally had to fight wits and courage on the last show, which was a bit tiring. I thought in my heart that this show would support my dreams. Now it seems that it feels like a mirror of the mirror, but now the mirror of the mirror is completely confirmed.
Thinking of this, I had an idea in my mind. This bottom should be considered a Li Daxiao-style baby bottom!
I said: "If we only use phoenix and eagle to compare the post-80s generation, but I think it is a bit missing. The type of the post-80s generation should be like a bird garden. As the saying goes, 'the forest is big, and there are all kinds of birds.' Look at our country's development so well now, does it look like a big forest?"
Zixuan laughed loudly: "Using birds as metaphors for people, this is possible, we now have a free and blue sky.
However, since there are hundreds of birds, it is appropriate to use phoenix and eagle as metaphors for the post-80s generation.
A hundred birds flock to the phoenix, right? "
I saw the steward at the scene making a clapping gesture to the audience.
Applause broke out after these words.
Although it’s not too loud, I know that Zixuan’s team is strong. Post-editing and adding effects such as the icing on the cake of individual audience members are definitely great.
The effect of the program I saw afterwards was indeed the same.
As soon as I heard what Zixuan said, I suddenly wanted to argue with her: "One of the obvious characteristics of the post-80s label is that they have a distinctive personality. They don't easily label themselves openly, and they don't easily sell their admiration to anyone at a cheap price.
When you say that hundreds of birds are paying homage to the phoenix, the implication is that as long as they are birds, they must pay homage to the phoenix.
I don't think the post-80s generation is like this. "
Zixuan caught me off guard like this. She was not angry but happy. Her big eyes were even more charming. Although this kind of charming eyes were different from the others.As for me, I don’t feel anything. Maybe the average man has already been deeply involved in it and can’t get out.
I only like the look in my wife's eyes. I was fascinated by her eyes when I first saw her. My writing skills are poor and I can't use words to describe the eyes of the goddess like Qu Yuan did. For me, I was happy as soon as I saw her eyes.
Zixuan said: "Do you mean that every bird can fly? The sky is high and the birds can fly?"
I said, “I think that’s the case, but of course it doesn’t mean that it’s all like this.
What I mean is that the generation born in the 1980s is a generation that has a lot to bear, and even more so, a generation that is under pressure. Quite a few of those born in the 1980s are only children, and they all have to face the reality of raising 411 children.
A couple supports four elderly people and one child. Now they are allowed to have a second child. The two parents may have six children. Maybe both parents have medical insurance and social security, but our generation is under a lot of mental pressure.
